children: Overview
Israel biopharma's Q2 revenue was flat yr/yr at $0.3 mln
Net loss widened to $4.3 mln from $3.9 mln on higher R&D and admin expenses
Company entered $3.75 mln financing agreement on Aug 27, 2026; expects cash runway into H1 2027
Outlook
Company maintains cash runway guidance into the first half of 2027
BioLineRx expects third patient cohort of GLIX1 trial to begin dosing in September
Company plans to add ovarian cancer arm to Phase 2a expansion of GLIX1 trial
Result Drivers
R&D SPENDING - Co said higher research and development expenses were mainly due to costs related to the new GLIX1 project
ADMIN EXPENSES - Co said general and administrative expenses rose due to reversal of a provision for doubtful accounts in prior period
APHEXDA ROYALTY - Q2 revenue was driven by royalty income from APHEXDA sales
